<!--
Feel free to include images / any markdown features to illustrate your suggestion. 
This _can_ also include asking to support a new minecraft version, though we would like to first get the mod to a stable point and implement most features.

Please also check if your feature has already been requested in another issue ticket.
-->

# Description of the feature / change
Describe what exactly you would want to have changed/added to this mod. Please be as clear as possible.
For example, if you want to propose a new lua api function, try to specify a concrete set of functions you would like to have implemented. 

As a more concrete example, if you would like support for RSA key generation, encryption and decryption, then state exactly that. List all the functionality that you would like, and **do not** simply state `I would like a cryptography component to be implemented`, as this is very vague and we might miss what you actually wanted to have added. 

An exception for this would be, if you are really just looking for general cryptographic functionality to be available and don't care about the specifics for your usecase, e.g. you do not care whether a certain algorithm is available (RSA vs ECDSA or AES vs ChaCha20 for instance).


# Example usecases <!-- feel free to remove section if not applicable -->
Include example usecases if possible.

For new lua functions this could be a set of lua snippets, along with a description of what would happen / be achieved in those snippets.
